params.message: Installing Node.js and core tools via winget
params.command: winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS -e --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements 2>&1 || echo done; winget install --id Git.Git -e --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements 2>&1 || echo done; winget install --id Python.Python.3.12 -e --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements 2>&1 || echo done

winget install --id Anaconda.Miniconda3 -e --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements 2>&1 || winget install --id Anaconda.Anaconda3 -e --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements 2>&1 || echo 'conda install skipped'

winget install --id SQLite.SQLite -e --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements 2>&1 || echo done; winget install --id Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools -e --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements 2>&1 || echo done
ollama pull qwen3-coder:14b 2>&1 || echo models will download later
